text:
emma: heads-up — BigBank just asked for a "route-to-dedicated" behavior during top-of-hour surges. They want requests pinned to dedicated capacity for 30–60s when their qps spikes above 2k.

javier: do we have a current mechanism to do short-lived overrides per-org? we have pins and sticky routing but those are long-lived and affect reuse.

sam: not really. we have per-org pins (reserved) and header-based routing (x-org-id -> route table) but no TTL.

nate: main risks: bypassing global quotas, double-billing, and state explosion on routing entries. we also need audit + easy revert.

emma: proposal: introduce a "surge-mitigation" policy type — evaluated in gateway. key parts:
- trigger: qps > threshold OR explicit header `x-redwood-surge:1`
- action: temporary weight shift: dedicated=90%, hosted=10%
- ttl: configurable per-org (default 60s)
- audit: write event to routing-audit log + emit metric `routing.surge.override`

javier: love it. how would we express the rule in config? something like:

```yaml
policies:
  - name: bigbank-surge
    match:
      org_id: "bigbank"
      condition: "qps > 2000"
    action:
      type: temporary_weight
      ttl_s: 60
      dedicated_weight: 0.9
```

jules: small ask — make sure this doesn't create sticky caches that circumvent KV-cache TTLs. temporary_weight should not affect KV prefix caching behavior.

sam: implementation note: gateway can maintain a small LRU map of active overrides with expiry. check capacity: 10k entries worst-case? fine but add eviction and instrumentation.

nate: quota handling: overrides must still respect org quotas. If org exceeds quota, route should 429 or fallback to degraded model, not silently route to cheaper hosted variant and incur cost.

emma: agreed — require that policy includes `quota_policy: enforce` by default.

javier: UX: add a checkbox in Console: "Allow temporary surge routing" with default off. Audit trail + who toggled.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: eng-platform/gateway v2.14 -> canary (10%) at 2026-03-19T15:30Z :rocket:

emma: action items:
- javier: spec + console toggle (ETA EOD Friday)
- sam: gateway LRU + eviction + metrics (ETA next Wed)
- jules: cache interaction tests (ETA next Tue)
- nate: quota fallback policy + test harness (ETA next Wed)

emma: thanks all. if BigBank needs this urgently we can do a temporary per-org hack (header-based TTL in routing layer) but prefer shipping a controlled policy.

javier: I'll draft RFC and ping legal for billing implications.

nate: also add a monitoring alert for a surge override rate > 1/min so SRE can review.

emma: cool. looping in @lia from sales for customer comms.
